source.note: This is a causal counterfactual re-label of the saved eight-wave sample path, not a fresh independent live window.

chronological_ridge_replay.method: At each snapshot wave, fit the same six-feature ridge only on labels whose target observation timestamp was already available at that wave; evaluate the current wave only after at least 40 prior causal labels.

interpretation: Changing the research horizon from 5s to 10s repairs the measurement cadence and reveals that the target is not identically flat. It does not rescue the current linear micro-taker: chronological ridge prediction is slightly worse than the zero forecast and has negative target correlation on this saved sample. Do not force taker trades or lower executable-edge gates. Fresh forward evidence with richer receive-time flow/OFI features is still required.
